items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: His versatility has enabled him to record with a lengthy list of diverse artists including Donald Fagen

ctx.x: Joe Ascione is one of the in-demand drummers in jazz today. His versatility has enabled him to record with a lengthy list of diverse artists including Donald Fagen, Ruby Braff, Dick Hyman and Dr. John. Joe appears at major jazz festivals here and abroad and regularly presents drum clinics to aspiring musicians across the country.
Joe was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 17, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
